|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Dead Ewok (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB3-42-Dead_Ewok-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Dead Ewok (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Dead Ewok (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Cancel Ellorrs Madak. [Immune to Sense] OR Use 2 Force to cancel the game text of an opponent’s alien for remainder of turn. OR Place an Ewok Catapult in opponent’s Used Pile. OR Make an Ewok power and forfeit = 0 for remainder of turn.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Dead Ewok (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “Ellorrs” to “Ellors” and writes the [Immune to Sense] icon out as “(Immune to Sense.)”: “Cancel Ellors Madak. (Immune to Sense.) OR Use 2 Force to cancel the game text of an opponent's alien for remainder of turn. OR Place an Ewok Catapult in opponent's Used Pile. OR Make an Ewok power and forfeit = 0 for remainder of turn.”.<ref name="cl-1230_41-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
